documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September 2026
Reconciliation Of Share Capital Audit For The Quarter Ended 30Th September 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Pricol Limited reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 1,083.58 crores and an EBITDA margin of 11.41% for Q1 FY27, driven by strong industry growth and new product introductions despite facing geopolitical and statutory cost headwinds. Management noted that earnings impacted by polymer prices, LPG costs, freight surges, and minimum wage hikes are delayed rather than lost and will be recovered through customer indexation in the next two to three quarters. The company is proceeding with a proposed demerger of its core driver information system and connected vehicle business to facilitate investments and technology partnerships. Additionally, Pricol has embarked on a Rs.

guidance.claim: Management maintains the steady state blended EBITDA margin target between 12.5% and 13%.
guidance.quote: Our ideal margin level for normal operations should be as I have always maintained between 12.5-13% which is the steady state margin so that we are not losing business, maintaining our share of business because if we endeavor to increase our margins beyond that, then competition will undercut us.

guidance.claim: Management maintains the target to achieve Rs. 8000 crores by Calendar Year 30 or FY31 through organic and inorganic growth.
guidance.quote: I have given a revenue guidance, I have told you Polymer business what capacity we are creating. We have also in the past given a revenue guidance for our DICVS business and we have said we hope to achieve Rs. 8000 crores by a combination of primarily organic and some amount of inorganic growth for Calendar Year ‘30 or FY31 of Rs. 8000 crores and I continue to maintain that.

guidance.claim: The management aims to double P3L's turnover within three years of taking over the company.
guidance.quote: And with regard to P3L, I have given a guidance that we aim to double the turnover in three years after taking over the company.

guidance.claim: The company expects a softening of earnings and a slowing of the automotive sector due to geopolitical headwinds.
guidance.quote: So, while we are not scaling back on any of our critical activities that is going to hamper the growth of the company, we do believe that there will be softening of earnings and slowing of the whole automotive sector on account of these geopolitical headwinds that are actually sending ripples across the world.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that industry demand continues to be robust.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of industry outlook, demand continues to be robust, but the resumption of the war in Iran and those neighboring regions will continue to have an impact on the rupee, which is at an all-time low against the US dollar.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the polymer space is currently muted due to a lack of capacity rather than a lack of business.
demand_outlook.quote: In the Polymer space, the growth is going to be muted as mentioned by me in the last call because of lack of capacity, not lack of business.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that geopolitical headwinds and rising costs are expected to cause a softening of earnings and slowing of the automotive sector.
demand_outlook.quote: So, while we are not scaling back on any of our critical activities that is going to hamper the growth of the company, we do believe that there will be softening of earnings and slowing of the whole automotive sector on account of these geopolitical headwinds that are actually sending ripples across the world.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has embarked on a Rs. 700-crore overall capex cycle over the next 18 to 24 months across all divisions.
capex_expansion.quote: We have embarked on a 700-crore overall CAPEX cycle across all divisions of the company, not just in the next 12 months, but over the next 18 to 24 months.

capex_expansion.claim: Approximately Rs. 400 crores of the capex is reserved for the polymer vertical to create new capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: About 400 crores of this is reserved for the Polymer vertical, where we are creating a lot of new capacity to cater to the existing business and also because we have to move out of the TVS campuses in which we had a lock-in period.

capex_expansion.claim: Approximately Rs. 300 crores of capex is allocated for the other two verticals, with 150 to 180 crores for DICVS and about 120 crores for ACFMS.
capex_expansion.quote: And about 300 crores is for the other two verticals of the company. Approximately 150 to 180 crores will be for the DICVS vertical and about 120 crores for the ACFMS vertical, broadly speaking.

capex_expansion.claim: The centre of excellence in polymer technology will become completely operational by May of 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: We are setting up a center of excellence in Polymer technology as we speak which will completely become operational by May of 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned a major capital expenditure of between INR 680 crores and INR 700 crores for the year.
capex_expansion.quote: In fact, this year, in itself, we have planned for about between INR 680 crore to INR 700 crores of CAPEX to cater to all of our new businesses that we have won, new plants, new machines, so on and so forth, which will keep propelling us forward and to maintain this growth momentum.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations was Rs. 1083.58 crores with an EBITDA of Rs. 123.69 crores and an EBITDA margin of 11.41%.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, our revenue from operations has been about Rs.1083.58 crores with an EBITDA of Rs.123.69 crores with an EBITDA margin of 11.41%, resulting in a profit after tax of Rs.67.02 crores with a PAT margin of 6.19%, resulting in an EPS of Rs.5.50 per one rupee share.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA faced headwinds due to the West Asia crisis causing spikes in polymer and LPG prices, higher freight costs, and sharp minimum wage increases across three operating states.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA has faced some headwinds, as I had already indicated earlier. Our EBITDA, on a quarter-on-quarter comparison between the same quarter for FY26 has grown by only 21.42%. We could have grown by a much higher percentage compared to our revenue, but there have been multiple headwinds caused by the West Asia crisis. Polymer prices have gone through the roof. LPG prices have gone sky high. Freight costs have increased. There has been surge pricing. There has been premium pricing. And minimum wages in three states that we are operating have also gone up very sharply because of the government intervention in the 1st Quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Polymer prices, aluminum, semiconductors, memory control devices, and freight costs have all experienced significant increases.
margins_costs.quote: Polymer prices have gone up by about 55%. Aluminum has gone up by about 62%. The semiconductors have gone up by about 35%. Memory control devices by about 28%. Freight costs are also spiraling out of control both inbound and outbound freight.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated there is typically a lag factor of six months for forex corrections.
margins_costs.quote: There is a lag factor of six months. So, we are only now getting corrections of FOREX for the Q3 of the last financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: The polymer business has a current turnover capability of around Rs. 1,000 crores, which will increase to about Rs. 2,000 crores with the ongoing capex.
orders_capacity.quote: With the capacity that we are creating, we should comfortably go to about Rs. 2000 crores of turnover from our current Rs. 1000 crores of turnover that we are capable of producing.

orders_capacity.claim: In the two-wheeler driver information system segment, Pricol holds a 30-35% volume share in India.
orders_capacity.quote: what is our market share in DIS its segment wise its is different in two wheeler DIS business we have largest in India with 30-35% volume share in CVs we have almost two third market share to CVs off road vehicles In passenger vehicles, we just have about 8-9% market share because at this point in time, we are only dependent on Tata Motors, where 8 out of 10 Tata cars are coming out with a PRICOL cluster.

orders_capacity.claim: Pricol has approximately two-third market share in commercial vehicles and off-road vehicles for driver information systems.
orders_capacity.quote: in CVs we have almost two third market share to CVs off road vehicles

orders_capacity.claim: In passenger vehicles, Pricol has about 8-9% market share, depending solely on Tata Motors.
orders_capacity.quote: In passenger vehicles, we just have about 8-9% market share because at this point in time, we are only dependent on Tata Motors, where 8 out of 10 Tata cars are coming out with a PRICOL cluster.

orders_capacity.claim: TFT penetration in the total two-wheelers produced is currently at about 7-8%.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, it is a very small percentage. About 7-8% of the total 2-wheelers produced is having TFT clusters.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has confirmed letters of intent for most of its instrument cluster programs for the next three years.
orders_capacity.quote: I do not see any dip in market share because we have got confirmed LOIs for most of the programs. So, for the next three years, barring degrowth or slowing down of the market, loss of market share is not something that we need to fear about.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's polymer division is currently unable to grow due to a lack of capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In fact, so much so that in plastics, we are unable to grow this year because of lack of capacity, which is why you see the ROCE at a very high figure compared to what I had given guidance for because of sweating the capital assets.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt stood at INR 63.11 crores as of 31st March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Just to give you a perspective, barring the supplier discounting and the customer bill discounting which earlier was hitherto treated as trade payable, now actual borrowing as of 31st March 2026, net debt is INR 63.11 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended retaining the dividend at 200% for FY26 to conserve cash in light of capital investments and headwinds.
capital_allocation.quote: So, this is something that we took a conscious call yesterday. We had the subject of the dividend, and the entire Board, including myself, recommended that we retain it at a 200% dividend for the FY26, see the performance for the next six months, and then take a call on that subject.

risks_headwinds.claim: Intelligence provided by shipping providers indicates that inbound and outbound freight rates will continue to be very high for at least the next four quarters.
risks_headwinds.quote: Freight rates are also at a high and expected to remain high for the next few quarters at least from the shipping providers, the intelligence provided by them is at least for the next four quarters shipping rates and freight rates both inbound and outbound will continue to be very high.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prices for memory controlled devices are increasing sharply due to the huge demand created by the global AI revolution.
risks_headwinds.quote: In addition, raw material prices other than basic raw materials like aluminums die casting and Polymer, even for memory controlled devices, which we are dependent on heavily, prices are increasing very, very sharply quarter on quarter because of the huge demand created by the AI revolution happening across the world.

risks_headwinds.claim: The financial year started off with a semiconductor crisis, a rare earth magnet crisis, and the West Asia crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: This financial year started off with a semiconductor crisis, followed by a rare earth magnet crisis, followed by the West Asia crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the Indian Rupee is on a free fall.
risks_headwinds.quote: The rupee is on a free fall.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to recover the earnings lost this quarter through indexation in the next two quarters.
management_commitments.quote: So, by the next two quarters, we will recover whatever earnings that we have lost this quarter on account of all these increases in costs and headwinds.

management_commitments.claim: Capacity expansion for the polymer business will take the next 9-12 months to mature.
management_commitments.quote: We have won a lot of business for which we are creating capacity, but that will take the next 9-12 months to mature, after which that business also will maintain a very healthy (+20%) growth rate.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to double the TFT penetration percentage in terms of adaptation over the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: But we see rapid growth in the next 2-3 years of doubling this percentage in terms of TFT adaptation.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the demerger process to take at the very minimum 4 quarters or longer.
management_commitments.quote: It is a million-dollar question. Sorry, because it is dependent on so many governmental agencies and multiple steps. But we have been told it will take at the very minimum 4 quarters or could be longer.

management_commitments.claim: Internally, each division will begin operating like demerged entities starting from October, and operate fully as demerged entities by December.
management_commitments.quote: Internally we will be starting to operate like demerged entities by October and by December it will be fully operated like demerged entities so that when the demerger happens it becomes easy.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to double P3L's turnover within a three-year timeframe from the takeover.
management_commitments.quote: And with regard to P3L, I have given a guidance that we aim to double the turnover in three years after taking over the company.

management_commitments.claim: Production with BOE is scheduled to commence in about 10 to 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: Work is under progress on the equipment and the machinery and the buildings, and we will be commencing in about 10 to 12 months' production.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial readiness with Domino is expected in 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: With Domino, more like 18 months to 24 months is where we will be ready, and the early stages of revenue will start trickling in, right?

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
